graph.title: LEGO Speed Racer 8159 Racer X & Taejo Togokhan (Racer X yellow car + red car)

new_part_types.name: Light gray plate with exhaust pipe

notes: Booklet 8159 has two separate models: the yellow Racer X car (bag 1, ids b1-b66 plus ywheel group) and the red car with Taejo Togokhan (bag 2, ids b100-b183 plus rwheel group). Ids are not contiguous.

The booklet gives only pictures and no Element IDs, so every piece was mapped to the closest catalogue type or a new type, with colour in props. Some mappings are approximate. They include the Racer X torso, the black 1x10 plates, the yellow 4x4 curved piece and the red wedges.
Several pieces from the inventory pages are not modelled or are only approximated. Examples are the small red and yellow 1x1/1x2 plates and tiles, the silver rims and the second steering base.
Stickers (numbered 1-27) are not modelled as parts.

Many joins are inferred from small isometric pictures. Which stud a given piece sits on is a best guess, so treat edges as plausible adjacency rather than exact. Examples are the join between the front and rear sub-assemblies of each car and the placement of the curved slopes, tiles and arches.
Both cars use a Technic axle on 2 axle positions with 2 wheels per axle. Each wheel is a hub, a tire and an end bush.
The minifigs sit in the cars. This is modelled as a contact edge because the legs have no connector in the catalogue.
The Z-shaped black brackets are mapped to lego-4282746. The black plate U-shapes in the red car are modelled as a 4x4 plate plus two 1x10 plates.
